parsed.rationale: All four duplicate `data` methods reside in `Shared/Artwork/Tests/ArtworkTests/ArtworkFetcherTests.swift` and are nested inside `SequentialMockSession` types that are themselves nested inside test classes (`iTunesArtworkServiceTests`, `LastFMArtworkServiceTests`, `DiscogsArtworkServiceTests`). Although the pipeline emitted `is_test: false` and `is_mock: false` for every record, the file path under `Tests/ArtworkTests/` and the enclosing type names (`SequentialMockSession`, `*Tests`) make the test-fixture nature unambiguous. Lifting these into shared production code would couple test scaffolding into the `Artwork` package's non-test targets. The duplication across per-service test classes is intentional: each `SequentialMockSession` is a local stub scoped to its enclosing test class, and consolidating them would obscure that per-service isolation.
